statement: Typography is the primary service actor: large, unmistakably human prompts create attention; quieter responses and actions answer without chatbot chrome, fashion-editorial distance, or a technical metadata voice.

roles.display: Spoken service prompts: expressive, direct, large-scale and human without looking whimsical, luxury-fashion, or software-generated.
roles.body: Calm responses, product explanation, place information and actions: highly legible, contemporary and warm enough to keep the exchange human.

antiPatterns: generic luxury high-contrast serif as automatic pâtisserie signal
monospace metadata layer used merely to look designed
overused geometric-sans neutrality that removes the human service voice
